invariants.rationale: The method always returns a Drawable from style fields, all of which are expected to be non-null if returned.
The return value is always one of the four knob variants from SliderStyle.
If disabled and style.disabledKnobBefore is not null, result must be that field; otherwise, not.
If dragging and knobBeforeDown is available (and prior disabled case did not trigger), result must be that field.

invariants.expression: ((SliderStyle)super.getStyle()).knobBefore == result || (((SliderStyle)super.getStyle()).disabledKnobBefore != null && disabled) || (((SliderStyle)super.getStyle()).knobBeforeDown != null && isDragging() && (!disabled || ((SliderStyle)super.getStyle()).disabledKnobBefore == null)) || (((SliderStyle)super.getStyle()).knobBeforeOver != null && mouseOver && (!disabled || ((SliderStyle)super.getStyle()).disabledKnobBefore == null) && (!isDragging() || ((SliderStyle)super.getStyle()).knobBeforeDown == null)))
invariants.rationale: If none of the conditional branches are taken, the fallback is style.knobBefore.
